title: cochlidium linearifolium
intro: Cochlidium linearifolium, commonly known as the "linear-leaved cochlidium", is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its ability to act as a decongestant and expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Cochlidium linearifolium include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
